goal: Design review: open every page with the Playwright browser tools at desktop and phone width, compare with docs/DESIGN.md, and fix templates, CSS and front-end scripts directly where they fall short.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every page matches docs/DESIGN.md at desktop and phone width

decisions.what: Clipped the portal wrapper horizontally and narrowed the portal to 100%/1.3 at <=599px
decisions.why: The rotating outer ring (1.24x the circle) widened Home to 400px at 375px
decisions.evidence: app/static/css/databoot.css .portal-wrap and the <=599px media block; sweep showed scrollWidth 375

decisions.what: Replaced the move and expand SVGs in _tile.html with the exact ones in DESIGN.md
decisions.why: Rendered icons differed from the spec (cross arrows, filled corners)

decisions.what: Corrected DESIGN.md for the scan h1 inside section.scan and the phone portal width
decisions.why: Doc should say what the code does after review

tried_and_failed.what: First sweep including /scan in the page loop
tried_and_failed.why_it_failed: /scan auto-navigates to the workspace, destroying the evaluate context; shot it separately after 900 ms

assumptions: Chromium's :focus-visible reports outlineStyle none on date inputs only in my loop's moment of sampling; a direct check showed the date input focused with a solid outline
No change needed for 800px since the grid has one column up to 899px and nothing changed there
open_questions: Hover glow and drag states were not re-verified visually; tests/test_tile_interactions.py passes

lessons.lesson: Sweep at 375px with scrollWidth, and treat decorative rotating or absolutely positioned rings as overflow suspects; clip them on their wrapper
lessons.when: Reviewing a page with decorative elements larger than their box
lessons.evidence: Home scrollWidth 400 before the fix, 375 after

lessons.lesson: Compare rendered icons with the exact SVG markup in DESIGN.md, not only their presence
lessons.evidence: _tile.html move and expand icons differed from DESIGN.md

lessons.lesson: Shoot /scan with a short wait (about 900 ms) in its own script, since scan.js navigates away
lessons.evidence: Playwright evaluate error 'Execution context was destroyed'
